turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Rohan from the Global Security Team. We have detected a critical synchronization error in your mobile banking application that could freeze your accounts today.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? I have not done anything wrong. My app is working fine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is a backend server issue, sir, but to prevent the freeze, I need to run a quick diagnostic. Please download the AnyDesk app from the play store so I can secure your profile.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: AnyDesk? I do not know how to use these things. Is this really necessary?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It only takes two minutes. Just open the app and tell me the nine digit code you see on the screen, and I will handle the rest for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, wait. I am opening it. The code is 421 558 903.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, I have access now. I can see the error, but to clear the security block, you must pay a one-time verification fee of nine thousand five hundred rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nine thousand five hundred! Why should I pay for a server error?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is a refundable security deposit. Please just send it to this UPI ID I am sending to your WhatsApp right now or your account will be locked.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I need to ask my son first. I cannot do this alone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: There is no time for your son, Mr. Sharma. If the payment is not done in five minutes, your funds will be inaccessible for thirty days.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Please wait, let me just check my balance first.
